proceedings.description: Submission of Matters to a Vote of Security Holders
proceedings.prior_quote: On May 14, 2026, the Annual Meeting of Shareholders of Ford Motor Company (the "Company") was held.
proceedings.current_quote: As previously disclosed, on December 13, 2024, BlueOval SK, LLC ("BOSK"), a joint venture company formed by Ford Motor Company ("Ford" or "Company"), SK On Co., Ltd. ("SK On"), and SK Battery America, Inc. ("SKBA," a wholly owned subsidiary of SK On) to build and operate an EV battery plant in Tennessee and two EV battery plants in Kentucky, entered into a Loan Arrangement and Reimbursement Agreement (the "BOSK DOE Loan Agreement") pursuant to which the U.S. Department of Energy ("DOE") agreed to arrange for the Federal Financing Bank to purchase a note or notes from BOSK and to make advances from time to time thereunder up to $9,633,040,000 (the "BOSK DOE Loan") to finance the construction of battery manufacturing plants in Tennessee and Kentucky.

findings.summary: Ford Motor Company filed two 8-K reports, one on May 14, 2026, and another on May 20, 2026, disclosing various events, including the submission of matters to a vote of security holders and the entry into a material definitive agreement.
